source.snippet: I use salesforce pub sub API to copy some data (account, contact and opportunity) to our data warehouse. For the first load I use Bulk API 2.0. After that CDC events for incremental updates. I use changedFields and nulledFields to update only fields which changed. When someone changes a custom field, new CDC event comes with a new schema id but sometimes our client still have the old schema in cache. Field positions in changefields bitmap don't match what our client expects. Yeah and the warehouse...

problem_statement: Developers syncing Salesforce data to a warehouse via CDC (Change Data Capture) face silent data corruption or pipeline failures when Salesforce object schemas change, because cached schema IDs become stale and field bitmap positions shift unexpectedly.
target_segment: Data engineers and backend developers at companies using Salesforce as a system of record with a downstream data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, etc.)
notes: Business context is clear — this is a production data pipeline copying CRM records (accounts, contacts, opportunities) to a warehouse. Schema drift causing silent corruption is a recurring engineering cost. Several paid ETL/ELT tools (Fivetran, Airbyte) compete here but the Salesforce CDC pub/sub path is underserved. A specialized connector or monitoring layer that handles schema evolution automatically would have clear enterprise buyer.
